difficultyReason: Straightforward modus ponens with transparent conditional structure: if-then premise, affirming antecedent, simple valid conclusion. Correct answer repeats the modus ponens form; distractors use other valid forms (universal instantiation) or invalid patterns.
stimulus: If the corporation issues new stock, then its shareholders will be diluted. The corporation issued new stock. Therefore, the shareholders were diluted.
questionStem: The reasoning in the argument above is most similar to the reasoning in which one of the following?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If a chemical reaction reaches a critical temperature, it will accelerate rapidly. This reaction has reached the critical temperature. Therefore, it will accelerate rapidly.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Metals conduct electricity. Copper is a metal. Therefore, copper conducts electricity.

choices.label: C
choices.text: If the defendant did not leave the premises, then the witness must be lying. The witness is not lying. Therefore, the defendant left the premises.

choices.label: D
choices.text: All glaciers are retreating due to climate change. The Athabaska Glacier is retreating. Therefore, it is a glacier.

choices.label: E
choices.text: If the patient takes the antibiotic, she will recover. If she recovers, she will return to work. The patient takes the antibiotic. Therefore, she will return to work.

explanations.correct: Stimulus: if P then Q; P; therefore Q (modus ponens). Choice A: if P then Q; P; therefore Q. Identical structure, different subject matter (chemistry vs. corporate finance).
explanations.B: Uses universal instantiation (all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B), not a conditional modus ponens.
explanations.C: Uses modus tollens (if P then Q; not Q; therefore not P), not modus ponens.
explanations.D: Uses invalid reasoning: all A are B; x is B; therefore x is A (affirming the consequent).
explanations.E: Uses conditional chain (if P then Q; if Q then R; P; therefore R), not simple modus ponens.

difficultyReason: Simple disjunctive syllogism: A or B; not A; therefore B. Clearly valid. Correct answer has identical structure; distractors use conditionals, valid but non-parallel forms, or mismatched strength.
stimulus: Either the supplier will deliver the goods on time, or the project will miss its deadline. The supplier did not deliver the goods on time. Therefore, the project will miss its deadline.
questionStem: Which one of the following arguments is most similar in its reasoning to the argument above?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The museum director must have either approved the acquisition or delegated the decision. The director did not approve it. Therefore, the director delegated the decision.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If the board approves the budget, then operations will continue. The board approved the budget. Therefore, operations will continue.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Most employees prefer remote work. Sarah is an employee. Therefore, Sarah probably prefers remote work.

choices.label: D
choices.text: All musical compositions require a composer. This symphony is a musical composition. Therefore, it has a composer.

choices.label: E
choices.text: The training program is effective if and only if participants pass the certification exam. Participants passed the exam. Therefore, the training program is effective.

explanations.correct: Stimulus: A or B; not A; therefore B (disjunctive syllogism). Choice A: A or B; not A; therefore B. Same structure, different context (project delivery vs. museum decisions).
explanations.B: Modus ponens (if P then Q; P; therefore Q), not disjunctive syllogism.
explanations.C: Universal instantiation with probability marker; different structure from the stimulus.
explanations.D: Universal instantiation (all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B), not disjunctive syllogism.
explanations.E: Biconditional affirmation; not the same as disjunctive syllogism.

difficultyReason: Modus tollens: if P then Q; not Q; therefore not P. Transparent and valid. Correct answer mirrors modus tollens; distractors include modus ponens (structural reversal) and invalid affirming-the-consequent patterns.
stimulus: If the contract is binding, then both parties have legal obligations. Both parties do not have legal obligations. Therefore, the contract is not binding.
questionStem: The pattern of reasoning in which one of the following is most parallel to that in the argument above?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If the defendant was at the crime scene, then the physical evidence would match. The physical evidence does not match. Therefore, the defendant was not at the crime scene.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If a language is widely spoken, it will be taught in schools. Latin is not widely spoken. Therefore, Latin is not taught in schools.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The medication must help with pain if patients report feeling better. Patients report feeling better. Therefore, the medication helps with pain.

choices.label: D
choices.text: All bacteria are prokaryotes. This organism is a prokaryote. Therefore, it is a bacterium.

choices.label: E
choices.text: If an economy exports more than it imports, it has a trade surplus. Some economies have a trade surplus. Therefore, they export more than they import.

explanations.correct: Stimulus: if P then Q; not Q; therefore not P (modus tollens). Choice A: if P then Q; not Q; therefore not P. Identical structure, different domain (law vs. contracts).
explanations.B: Denies the antecedent (if P then Q; not P; therefore not Q), which is invalid but a common trap.
explanations.C: Affirms the consequent (if P then Q; Q; therefore P), structurally invalid.
explanations.D: Universal instantiation with invalid affirming-the-consequent (all A are B; x is B; therefore x is A).
explanations.E: Partial affirmation of a conditional with only subset confirmation; not modus tollens.

difficultyReason: Conditional chain: if P then Q; if Q then R; P; therefore R. Transparent and valid. Correct answer uses the same chain structure; distractors use simpler conditionals or branch into analogies.
stimulus: If the server goes offline, then data will not sync. If data does not sync, then users will experience errors. The server went offline. Therefore, users will experience errors.
questionStem: Which one of the following arguments is most similar in its reasoning to the argument above?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If the artist receives the commission, she will begin painting. If she begins painting, she will complete the work in time. The artist received the commission. Therefore, she will complete the work in time.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If the interest rate rises, then inflation decreases. Interest rates have risen. Therefore, inflation has decreased.

choices.label: C
choices.text: All architects design buildings. Frank is an architect. Therefore, Frank designs buildings.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Either the engine is broken or the fuel tank is empty. The engine is not broken. Therefore, the fuel tank is empty.

choices.label: E
choices.text: If a policy is unpopular, the administration will reconsider it. The administration will reconsider the policy. Therefore, the policy is unpopular.

explanations.correct: Stimulus: if P then Q; if Q then R; P; therefore R (conditional chain). Choice A: if P then Q; if Q then R; P; therefore R. Identical structure, different subject (art commission vs. technology).
explanations.B: Simple modus ponens (if P then Q; P; therefore Q), not a chain.
explanations.C: Universal instantiation (all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B).
explanations.D: Disjunctive syllogism (A or B; not A; therefore B).
explanations.E: Affirms the consequent (if P then Q; Q; therefore P), which is invalid.

difficultyReason: Universal instantiation: all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B. Very straightforward categorical syllogism. Correct answer uses the same form; distractors include conditionals, invalid reversals, or disjunctions.
stimulus: All insects have six legs. A butterfly is an insect. Therefore, a butterfly has six legs.
questionStem: The reasoning in the argument above is most similar to the reasoning in which one of the following?

choices.label: A
choices.text: All peer-reviewed journals are credible sources. The New England Journal of Medicine is a peer-reviewed journal. Therefore, it is a credible source.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If an organism is a mammal, it has a backbone. Dolphins are mammals. Therefore, dolphins have backbones.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Some birds migrate south in winter. The robin is a bird. Therefore, the robin migrates south in winter.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Rocks are either igneous or sedimentary. This rock is igneous. Therefore, it is not sedimentary.

choices.label: E
choices.text: If a food contains peanuts, it should be labeled as such. Peanut oil may not be labeled. Therefore, peanut oil does not contain peanuts.

explanations.correct: Stimulus: all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B (universal instantiation). Choice A: all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B. Identical structure, different domain (biology vs. academic publishing).
explanations.B: Uses conditional framing (if-then) rather than universal categorical form.
explanations.C: Partial quantifier (some) rather than universal (all); invalid inference.
explanations.E: Conditional with invalid modus tollens application.

difficultyReason: Analogy: X is like Y in respects P and Q; Y has property R; therefore X has R. Clear and transparent. Correct answer uses parallel analogy; distractors use conditional, categorical, or disjunctive forms that obscure the structural match.
stimulus: This management consulting firm is similar to a teaching hospital in its emphasis on mentorship and its commitment to knowledge-sharing. Teaching hospitals produce excellent physicians. Therefore, this consulting firm will produce excellent consultants.
questionStem: Which one of the following arguments is most similar in its reasoning to the argument above?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A startup incubator resembles a successful seed fund in its focus on early-stage investment and its hands-on guidance. Seed funds often identify industry leaders. Therefore, this startup incubator will likely identify future leaders.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If a company invests in employee development, it will retain talented workers. This company invests heavily in development. Therefore, it will retain talented workers.

choices.label: C
choices.text: All professional sports teams require dedication and skill. The local basketball team is a professional team. Therefore, it requires dedication and skill.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Either the product was defective or the customer misused it. The product was not defective. Therefore, the customer misused it.

choices.label: E
choices.text: If an organization prioritizes community engagement, it builds public trust. If it builds trust, it attracts donors. The nonprofit prioritizes engagement. Therefore, it will attract donors.

explanations.correct: Stimulus: X is like Y in properties P and Q; Y has R; therefore X has R (analogy). Choice A: X is like Y in properties P and Q; Y has R; therefore X has R. Identical analogical structure, different context (incubator vs. consulting firm).
explanations.B: Modus ponens (if P then Q; P; therefore Q), not analogical reasoning.
explanations.C: Universal instantiation (all A are B; x is A; therefore x is B).
explanations.D: Disjunctive syllogism (A or B; not A; therefore B).
explanations.E: Conditional chain (if P then Q; if Q then R; P; therefore R), not analogy.
